explanation: Prefix locality of bounded runs: a run of at most m steps on x equals the run on x.take m (the input head starts at cell 1 and moves at most one cell per step; the induction is a self-contained copy of cslib-frontier's PrefixLocality.runFrom_eq_of_prefix_agree, whose module is not prebuilt in the environment). Hence for A.time <= m, D.bind A.run = (D.map (take m)).bind A.run, so the acceptance probabilities agree and the gain is 0. For A.time > m, 2^k * gain <= 2^k <= m + 1 <= time <= cost.
